{
  "candidate_rtl": "module crc32_d8 (
    input  wire [7:0]  data_in,
    input  wire [31:0] state_in,
    output wire [7:0]  data_out,
    output wire [31:0] state_out
);
    // Factor the eight input/state pairs before the parallel CRC network.
    wire [7:0] q;
    assign q = data_in ^ state_in[7:0];

    // Constant elaboration-time symbolic simulation of eight reflected steps.
    // Each symbolic bit describes a linear combination of q[7:0].
    function [7:0] crc_mask;
        input integer index;
        reg [7:0] s [0:31];
        reg [7:0] f [0:7];
        reg [7:0] feedback;
        reg [31:0] polynomial;
        integer i, j;
        begin
            polynomial = 32'hedb88320;
            for (j = 0; j < 32; j = j + 1)
                s[j] = 8'b0;
            for (i = 0; i < 8; i = i + 1) begin
                feedback = s[0] ^ (8'b00000001 << i);
                f[i] = feedback;
                for (j = 0; j < 31; j = j + 1)
                    s[j] = s[j+1];
                s[31] = 8'b0;
                for (j = 0; j < 32; j = j + 1)
                    if (polynomial[j])
                        s[j] = s[j] ^ feedback;
            end
            if (index < 32)
                crc_mask = s[index];
            else
                crc_mask = f[index-32];
        end
    endfunction

    genvar n;
    generate
        for (n = 0; n < 32; n = n + 1) begin : state_bits
            localparam [7:0] MASK = crc_mask(n);
            if (n < 24) begin : with_shifted_state
                crc32_d8_mask_xor #(.MASK(MASK), .HAS_TAIL(1)) network (
                    .q(q), .tail(state_in[n+8]), .y(state_out[n])
                );
            end else begin : without_shifted_state
                crc32_d8_mask_xor #(.MASK(MASK), .HAS_TAIL(0)) network (
                    .q(q), .tail(1'b0), .y(state_out[n])
                );
            end
        end
        for (n = 0; n < 8; n = n + 1) begin : data_bits
            localparam [7:0] MASK = crc_mask(32+n);
            crc32_d8_mask_xor #(.MASK(MASK), .HAS_TAIL(0)) network (
                .q(q), .tail(1'b0), .y(data_out[n])
            );
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule

module crc32_d8_mask_xor #(
    parameter [7:0] MASK = 8'b0,
    parameter integer HAS_TAIL = 0
) (
    input  wire [7:0] q,
    input  wire tail,
    output wire y
);
    function integer popcount;
        input [7:0] value;
        integer k;
        begin
            popcount = 0;
            for (k = 0; k < 8; k = k + 1)
                popcount = popcount + value[k];
        end
    endfunction

    localparam integer COUNT = popcount(MASK);
    localparam integer TOTAL = COUNT + HAS_TAIL;
    localparam integer WIDTH = (TOTAL > 0) ? TOTAL : 1;
    wire [WIDTH-1:0] terms;

    genvar k;
    generate
        for (k = 0; k < 8; k = k + 1) begin : selected_terms
            if (MASK[k]) begin : selected
                localparam integer POSITION = popcount(MASK & ((8'b1 << k)-8'b1));
                assign terms[POSITION] = q[k];
            end
        end
        if (HAS_TAIL != 0) begin : tail_term
            assign terms[COUNT] = tail;
        end
        if (TOTAL == 0) begin : empty_terms
            assign terms[0] = 1'b0;
        end
    endgenerate

    crc32_d8_balanced_xor #(.WIDTH(WIDTH)) tree (.a(terms), .y(y));
endmodule

module crc32_d8_balanced_xor #(
    parameter integer WIDTH = 1
) (
    input  wire [WIDTH-1:0] a,
    output wire y
);
    generate
        if (WIDTH == 1) begin : leaf
            assign y = a[0];
        end else begin : branch
            localparam integer LEFT = WIDTH / 2;
            localparam integer RIGHT = WIDTH - LEFT;
            wire lo, hi;
            crc32_d8_balanced_xor #(.WIDTH(LEFT)) left_tree (
                .a(a[LEFT-1:0]), .y(lo)
            );
            crc32_d8_balanced_xor #(.WIDTH(RIGHT)) right_tree (
                .a(a[WIDTH-1:LEFT]), .y(hi)
            );
            assign y = lo ^ hi;
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The original parallel equations repeatedly combine matching low state bits and data bits inside wider parity cones. Mapped arrival is sensitive to XOR depth, sharing, and fanout on those repeated inputs. No mapped timing report was available to identify the actual worst endpoint.",
  "rewrite": "Specialize to the fixed reflected CRC32 byte update. Compute q = data_in XOR state_in[7:0] once, derive constant linear masks for both output buses, and implement each compacted mask with an explicitly balanced XOR tree. Include the shifted upper-state contribution directly as a tree input rather than appending a separate output XOR. The symbolic shift loop executes only during constant elaboration; it does not create an eight-step runtime feedback chain.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce repeated parity work and control logical depth relative to unfactored input/state equations. A numerical timing gain or globally minimum mapped arrival cannot be established without running the specified synthesis and timing flow. Mapping may restructure the trees, and shared-q fanout may limit the benefit.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Factoring removes duplicated input/state pair computations, while balanced per-output trees may sacrifice some cross-output sharing. Buffering of q can add area. The 2752.640000 um^2 cap, zero electrical violations, and native/mapped SAT passes remain unverified; no tool results are claimed.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the exact port names, widths, and directions. The intended equivalence covers all 40 arbitrary binary input bits and all 40 output bits, including the eight successive reflected feedback values on data_out. No initialization, framing, reset, inversion, or valid assumptions are used. The design is purely combinational, has no external dependencies, and specializes only the supplied fixed instance. Full native and mapped equivalence proofs are required before acceptance."
}
